THE RITU FEEL

Calm, clear and made to feel human.

Every part of Ritu follows the same visual and writing principles so the experience stays gentle and easy to understand.

01

Calm by design

Soft seasonal colours, generous spacing and simple screens keep attention on what matters.

02

Clear, not clinical

Ritu explains patterns in plain language and avoids making the experience feel medical or intimidating.

03

Accessible & personal

Language, region and companion cues adapt so different people can use Ritu comfortably.

PRIVACY GUIDELINES

Your cycle story stays yours.

Ritu is designed to keep everyday tracking private, understandable and in your control.

01

Saved on this device

Your profile, cycle dates, moods, symptoms and notes stay on the device you use for Ritu.

02

Connected only when you ask

Weather, translation, nutrition and Nila’s chat are used only when you open those features.

03

You stay in control

Use Ritu on a trusted device, review your settings anytime, and clear your local profile when you no longer need it.

04

Guidance, not diagnosis

Cycle predictions and wellness suggestions are estimates for awareness and should not replace professional medical care.

FOOD BASICS

Why nourishment matters

Different phases can change appetite and energy. Use these as simple food ideas, not strict rules.

🥬

Iron

Supports healthy red blood cells. Try leafy greens, lentils, beans or meat.

🌰

Magnesium

Found in nuts, seeds, legumes and dark chocolate.

🥚

Protein

Helps with fullness and repair. Think eggs, yoghurt, lentils, fish or tofu.

🍓

Fibre + fluids

Fruit, vegetables, whole grains and water support comfortable digestion.
